in_hebrew.name: Estrella
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Estrella הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Means 'star' in Spanish. Derived from the Latin 'astrum', meaning 'star'. Often given to babies born under a bright star in the night sky, or to those with a bright future ahead of them.

in_greek.name: Estrella
in_greek.long_meaning: Estrella είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Means 'star' in Spanish. Derived from the Latin 'astrum', meaning 'star'. Often given to babies born under a bright star in the night sky, or to those with a bright future ahead of them.

in_latin.name: Estrella
in_latin.meaning: nomen significans stellam nocturnam, astra mundi
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen 'Estrella' originem habet e lingua Latina et connectio habet cum astrologo mythico. Estrella significat periculum et voluntatem. Estrella voluntas est ut sit plus astrorum. Estrella potest significare naturam astrorum suam. Estrella nomen habet magnam significatio in cultura Ecclesiae Latinae.
